PROC-CT-001 needs multiple lights and an oblique_low view, and PROC-CT-002 is about crazing and structural cracks that need relief or raking light, so neither applies here. CT-4 requires comparison with the approved reference, and it has not been fetched (matches_reference=None, comparison says single image only). The overall surface is a uniform speckled glaze. The only findings are a few tiny isolated marks, all rated high uncertainty and none a clear texture-breaking localized region like a crack, glue strip, gray stroke, oil or rough patch. Without the reference I cannot say whether they are defects or normal variation, so neither a defect nor a no-defect verdict is supported. Fetch the reference and then decide.
